entities.description: An elderly man with short, wavy white hair and heavily wrinkled skin is shown in profile, gently pressing his forehead against the head of a young child with blonde hair. He is wearing a white polo shirt with dark blue trim on the collar and sleeves, and has a soft, affectionate expression on his face.

A young boy with short, tousled blonde hair is shown in profile, wearing a white polo shirt with dark blue trim on the collar and sleeves. He has a gentle, subtle smile and is leaning his head against the shoulder of an older person, whose white hair and arm are partially visible on the right side of the frame.

attributes.pose: sitting, leaning head on another person's shoulder
attributes.position: left of frame, next to an older person
